meta.name: anndata
meta.description: Data structure for annotated matrices in single-cell analysis. Use when working with .h5ad files or integrating with the scverse ecosystem. This is the data format skill—for analysis workflows use scanpy; for probabilistic models use scvi-tools; for population-scale queries use cellxgene-census.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 读入并组织单细胞测序产生的注释矩阵,为下游分析打好基础。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果处理单细胞测序结果,需要按注释矩阵整理基因表达数据。
copy.tagline_en: Read and organize annotated single-cell matrices for downstream analysis.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you handle single-cell sequencing data and need a standard way to organize annotated expression matrices.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能帮你处理带注释的单细胞数据矩阵:创建、读写 AnnData 对象,拼接多个数据集,按元数据做子集筛选,并用稀疏矩阵或 backed 模式应对大文件。
howto.when: 当你处理 .h5ad、.zarr 等文件,或要把数据接入 scanpy 等 scverse 生态工具时触发。纯分析流程、概率模型、群体规模查询分别交给其他技能。

say.note: 用 ad.read_h5ad 读取并打印维度

把 X 转成稀疏矩阵,再写一份 gzip 压缩的 h5ad

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can work with annotated single-cell matrices: create, read and write AnnData objects, concatenate datasets, subset by metadata, and use sparse or backed mode for large files.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you handle .h5ad, .zarr or similar files, or hook data into scverse tools like scanpy. Analysis workflows, probabilistic models and population-scale queries belong to other skills.

say_en.text: Read data.h5ad and tell me how many cells and genes it has
say_en.note: Loads via ad.read_h5ad and prints dims
